title: California Condors Rebounded To 500
closing: The rescue worked, but lead poisoning means protection cannot stop now.
question: Have you ever seen a condor?

segments.say: California condors fell to 27 birds. One disaster could have erased the species.
California condors rebounded to 500 birds. Captive breeding reversed a collapse once considered nearly final.
Lead poisoning causes 50 percent of known deaths. Recovery still depends on removing that preventable threat.
